body.x: Sharp unveiled a new line of Aquos TVs at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
At the CES Press Conference, Sharp President John Herrington took the stage and outlined the scope of the Aquos line, from Full HD to 4K. "Storytelling becomes more powerful and emotional," he added.

Quattron+ is the highest-resolution 1080p TV, with splittable subpixels and able to play 4K content. "We have fully redesigned Quattron, delivering 33 percent more subpixels than standard HD televisions." explained, Herrington.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
